title: On the convexity of the KdV Hamiltonian
date_note: The versioned arXiv PDF is labelled v1/20 February 2015 but prints March 8, 2022; the downloaded bytes, rather than an assumed typesetting date, are pinned.

main_theorems.label: Theorem 1.1
statement_components: One complex open neighborhood V of the entire nonnegative ell2 action quadrant and an analytic extension of the physical renormalized KdV Hamiltonian to V.
The bilinear Hilbert gradient agrees coordinatewise with the existing KdV frequencies minus 8*pi^3*n^3 on V intersect V0.
Gradient at zero is zero and its full bounded derivative is -6 times identity.
An analytic local diffeomorphism near zero on complex ell2.
One positive radius, chosen before I and J, for the real Hessian bound d2H(I)[J,J] <= -norm(J)^2 on nonnegative ell2 actions, for every real ell2 direction J.
main_theorems.domain: Positive-index actions (I_n) for n >= 1; nonnegative includes zero coordinates; original Hkdv on weighted ell^(3,1)_+.
main_theorems.topology: Norm topology on complex ell2; open ambient extension around every cone point.
remaining: Complete intrinsic singular-Hill operator identification and global labels, finite central contours, full canonical unsquared continuation and cubic nonpositivity. Every actual real H^-1 characteristic zero, including central and multiple roots, is now proved real; the actual root and primitive cover both nonreal half-planes, satisfy exact Schwarz reflection, and give real Arnold/cubic contour periods on admissible real-centered circles.

Identify the actual Arnold periods with the action coordinates of the same global H^-1 KdV Birkhoff map used in the article. The proved estimates concern the constructed spectral periods, not an arbitrary coordinate map.

Apply the proved simultaneous descent/gluing and exact weighted-action summation mechanism to the actual KdV Birkhoff-coordinate cubic periods. This still requires the actual global H^-1 Birkhoff map and Arnold-period action identity, real isospectral invariance on its action fibers, and analytic finite central periods. No common action domain is now required as a separate abstract hypothesis.
Identify the analytically summed contour series with physical renormalized energy using the finite-gap trace formula and density.
Identify its bilinear Hilbert gradient with physical KdV frequencies minus 8*pi^3*n^3 on the full common domain.
Prove the KdV quadratic Taylor coefficients giving -6*Id.
Complete positive-index Hessian and real-cone transport for the earlier Coeff-based local concavity adapter.

main_theorems.label: Theorem 1.2
statement_components: For every real s in [-1/2,0] and every finite p >= 2, the same global H^-1 KdV Birkhoff map restricts to a real analytic diffeomorphism from L_0^(s,p) onto ell_0^(s+1/2,p).
main_theorems.domain: Real, mean-zero periodic distributions; two-sided complex sequence coordinates with z_0=0 and z_-n=conj(z_n).
main_theorems.topology: Fourier-Lebesgue and weighted sequence Banach norm topologies; not weak-star endpoints.
remaining: Fourier-Lebesgue spectral asymptotics and analytic restriction
Surjectivity by action reduction, plus inverse regularity

main_theorems.label: Theorem 1.3
statement_components: For every s in [-1/2,0] and every finite p >= 2 the KdV initial value problem is globally C0 well-posed on the real mean-zero Fourier-Lebesgue space L_0^(s,p).
main_theorems.domain: All real initial data in L_0^(s,p), all real times; solutions interpreted through the distributional H^-1 framework referenced by the paper.
main_theorems.topology: Continuity of trajectories and dependence on initial data in the Fourier-Lebesgue norm, compatible with the H^-1 solution notion.
main_theorems.proof_note: Presented in the introduction as an immediate application of Theorem 1.2 and the previously constructed KdV frequency/solution theory; no separately labelled proof later.
remaining: Physical KdV frequency reality and coordinate continuity
Conjugation of sequence phase flow by the same physical KdV Birkhoff map
Agreement/uniqueness with accepted H^-1 distributional solution theory

local_spectral_progress.matching: The local squared primitive agrees with the square of every sufficiently small normalized branch satisfying 2*cosh(F)=sigma*Delta, sigma^2=1.

source_continuation_progress.domain: Energy in the complex slit plane; Delta(lambda,s*q)^2-4 nonzero for every real s in [0,1].
source_continuation_progress.continued_root_conjugation: r(conj(lambda),q)=-conj(r(lambda,q)) on the admissible source domain at real continuous q.
source_continuation_progress.continued_primitive_conjugation: F(conj(lambda),q)=-conj(F(lambda,q)) on the admissible source domain at real continuous q.

high_contour_progress.high_contour_family: Image under lambda=z^2 of the counterclockwise circle C(n*pi,pi/4), n>N.
high_contour_progress.quantifiers: For every q, exists N>0 and complex open V containing q, before every a in V and every n>N. All source potentials s*a with 0<=s<=1 avoid the actual branch locus on those contours.
high_contour_progress.unqualified_action_bound_scope: Global physical H^-1/Birkhoff actions; still open.

high_energy_pair_progress.energy_region: Image of B(n*pi,pi/4) under lambda=z^2, for positive high indices
high_energy_pair_progress.endpoint_trace_levels: Both Delta values equal 2 for even n and -2 for odd n
high_energy_pair_progress.analytic_energy_midpoint: m^2+g/4=(l+r)/2, using intrinsic frequency midpoint m and squared gap g
high_energy_pair_progress.reality_scope: Real continuous potentials only; actual Green identity for any unit-modulus Floquet multiplier.
high_energy_pair_progress.endpoint_limit_scope: At every actual high radicand zero, for real continuous potentials on a common complex neighborhood and cutoff, from both nonreal energy half-planes; no simplicity assumed. Literal values at excluded branch points not asserted.
high_energy_pair_progress.unqualified_action_bound_scope: Global physical H^-1/Birkhoff actions; still open.

primitive_sheet_progress.potential_space: C([0,1], C), real-valued locus, no norm smallness assumption
primitive_sheet_progress.proof_method: Actual scalar IVP conjugation, Green identity, connected real source continuation and free anchoring.

high_endpoint_progress.potential_space: C([0,1], C), common complex potential neighborhood; unsquared off-real endpoint limits additionally assume real q.
high_endpoint_progress.joint_squared_primitive_matching_scope: One joint analytic square on a complete energy disc enclosing the actual straight complex high-gap segment. Endpoint deflation and analytic cut roots are constructed, with local physical sign matching. Central gaps and global physical sign matching remain open.

whole_high_gap_square_progress.quantifiers: For every q, exists r>0, N>0 and complex open V containing q, before all n>=N, all a in V and their actual gap pairs.
whole_high_gap_square_progress.frequency_radius: 0<r<=pi/4, chosen once for the entire high tail.

gap_scale_and_cut_root_progress.quantifiers: For every potential q, one r>0, C>0, N>0 and complex open V containing q precede every n>=N and every a in V.
gap_scale_and_cut_root_progress.actual_primitive_bound_domain: Intersection of the gap-sized disc with the actual source-continuation domain.
gap_scale_and_cut_root_progress.cut_square_root_domain: ball((n*pi)^2,n*pi*r) minus segment R l_n u_n
gap_scale_and_cut_root_progress.cut_square_root_gap_bound: norm(B_n)<=3*norm(l_n-u_n)/(pi*r*n) throughout the gap-sized disc minus the segment

actual_cubic_gap_moment_progress.quantifiers: For each potential q, one C>0, N>0 and complex open V containing q precede every n>=N and every a in V.
actual_cubic_gap_moment_progress.moment: Literal classicalHillHighContourMoment, with factor 1/pi, shift F+i*n*pi and exact energy pullback Jacobian 2*z.
actual_cubic_gap_moment_progress.physical_action_gap_comparison_scope: Global H^-1/Birkhoff action identification and bounds; still open.

physical_L2_primitive_agreement_progress.continuous_source: C(AddCircle 2,C), restricted to [0,1] for the actual scalar Hill flow
physical_L2_primitive_agreement_progress.agreement_potential_scope: Arbitrary complex continuous circle Q for domain/root/primitive agreement; period-one Q for the checked high Arnold-circle identification.
physical_L2_primitive_agreement_progress.action_gap_comparison_scope: Uniform complex L2 neighborhoods for the actual source-normalized energy-circle Arnold periods. Global H^-1/Birkhoff action identification remains open.

free_gap_quotient_normalization_progress.quantifiers: For each q, one r>0 with r<=pi/4 precedes every error tolerance. For each tolerance there are a positive cutoff N and a complex open V containing q, before all n>=N, all a in V and all energy-disc points.
free_gap_quotient_normalization_progress.actual_square_to_either_model_bound: epsilon*r^2, with r chosen before epsilon
free_gap_quotient_normalization_progress.actual_action_gap_lower_comparison_scope: Constructed continuous-potential Arnold period on the original high contour; not yet the global H^-1 Birkhoff action.

arnold_action_comparison_progress.quantifiers: For every continuous complex q, one positive cutoff N, one complex open V containing q, and one positive moment-bound constant precede all n>=N and all a in V.
arnold_action_comparison_progress.zero_locus: classicalHillHighContourAction n a = 0 iff l = u for the actual high pair

L2_contour_agreement_progress.continuous_domain: Complex C(AddCircle 2,C), restricted to period-one potentials in the contour-agreement and bound conclusions.
L2_contour_agreement_progress.common_neighborhood_quantifiers: For each continuous Q, one positive cutoff and one complex open U containing Q precede every period-one A in U and every n above the cutoff.
L2_contour_agreement_progress.uniform_estimate_topology: Complex L2 norm; proved directly for actual L2 periods, without inference from continuous-potential bounds.

L2_disc_trace_approximation_progress.potential_space: Complex Coeff 2, the actual L2 Fourier coefficient Banach space
L2_disc_trace_approximation_progress.quantifiers: For each q, 0<r<=pi/4 and epsilon>0, one positive cutoff N and complex L2-open V containing q precede every a in V, every integer n with N<=abs(n), and every point z of the full disc.
L2_disc_trace_approximation_progress.source_path: Same N,V work for every (s:C)*a with real 0<=s<=1

L2_whole_gap_square_progress.potential_space: Full complex Coeff 2, the actual L2 Fourier coefficient Banach space
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.Fourier_realization: Period-two coefficient model; physical period-one potentials are the even-supported subspace. The whole ambient space parametrizes the actual unit-interval trace by restriction.
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.source_phase_uniformity: One complex L2 neighborhood and cutoff precede every high quarter-pi frequency disc, every nearby potential and every straight source path.
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.free_normalized_strip: abs(Im(F(z^2,a)+i*n*pi))<pi/2 at every admissible source point on each whole high disc
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.square_family_quantifiers: For each q and each B>0, choose r>0, N>0 and a complex L2-open V containing q before every n>=N. One K_n is jointly analytic on a neighborhood of the entire closed energy disc times V, with norm(K_n)<B.
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.exact_zero_locus: K_n(lambda,a)=0 iff hillL2Radicand a lambda=0 throughout the full disc
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.actual_source_primitive_matching: K_n=(hillL2ContinuedPrimitive+i*n*pi)^2 at every source-admissible point of the disc times V
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.multiplicity_scope: For every analytic normalized square satisfying the local squared-cosh relation, its energy analytic order equals the actual radicand order, including multiple zeros.
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.joint_branch_limit: F tends to -i*n*pi as (lambda,a) tends to any actual branch point in the closed high disc times V through source-admissible points there.
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.joint_branch_limit_topology: Joint complex energy and L2 potential norm topology
L2_whole_gap_square_progress.high_pair_data: Actual unordered energy zeros, exact Multiset(l,u) multiplicities, parity trace levels, analytic energy midpoint and squared gap; unique up to exchange.

L2_uniform_moment_family_progress.physical_period_one_inputs: Even-supported subspace in the existing period-two Fourier model
L2_uniform_moment_family_progress.frequency_annulus: Any prescribed inner radius 0<r<=pi/4 inside the high quarter-pi frequency disc
L2_uniform_moment_family_progress.quantifiers: One positive cutoff N and complex L2-open V containing q precede all nearby a in V, all n>=N and all shell points.

L2_quantitative_period_progress.potential_space: Full complex Coeff 2 with its L2 norm; physical period-one inputs are the even-supported subspace of the period-two Fourier model.
L2_quantitative_period_progress.quantifiers: For each q there are C>0, N>0 and a complex L2-open V containing q, before every n>=N and every nearby a in V. The actual cubic and level-zero Arnold periods are analytic on that same V.
L2_quantitative_period_progress.actual_Arnold_period_A_n: hillL2HighContourMoment n 0 = -(1/pi)*integral_energy_circle F, center (n*pi)^2 and radius n
L2_quantitative_period_progress.actual_cubic_period_R_n: hillL2HighCubicContourMoment n = (1/pi)*integral_energy_circle(F+i*n*pi)^3, same center and radius
L2_quantitative_period_progress.uniform_filled_quotient_bound: norm(Q_n)<=4/(n*pi*r)^2 on the full closed energy disc
L2_quantitative_period_progress.uniform_primitive_square_gap_bound: norm(K_n)<=9*norm(gamma_n)^2/(n*pi*r)^2 on the full gap-length disc
L2_quantitative_period_progress.cut_matching_circle: radius R/4 where R=n*pi*r; R/4<=n because r<=pi/4 and pi<4
L2_quantitative_period_progress.cut_sign_matching: One sign on a connected energy circle; no global sign on all overlap components is assumed.
L2_quantitative_period_progress.free_scalar_models_reused: classicalHillFreeShiftedSquare and classicalHillFreeQuadraticModel are pure energy/index scalar functions, with no continuous-potential input.
L2_quantitative_period_progress.normalized_quotient_comparison: norm(4*(n*pi)^2*Q_n+1)<=epsilon on the full closed energy disc
L2_quantitative_period_progress.energy_analytic_unit_root: H_n^2=Q_n and norm(H_n-i/(2*n*pi))<=epsilon/(2*n*pi), uniformly in nearby complex L2 potentials
L2_quantitative_period_progress.exact_zero_locus: A_n=0 iff the actual high pair collapses

Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.potential_space: WeightedCoeff (Weight.sobolev (-1)) 2, full complex space in its H^-1 norm
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.Fourier_normalization: Unit-period coefficients; derivative symbol 2*pi*i*k. A later periodDouble is needed when entering the ambient period-two Hill model.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.kernel_smallness: The inverse-symbol coefficient sequence kappa_m tends to zero in ell2 as m tends to infinity.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.actual_quadratic_term: Raw coefficients are the absolutely convergent sums sum_j v_(k-j)*w_j; Young ell2*ell2 -> ellInfinity and the inverse bracket give H^-1 membership.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.fixed_point_method: Banach contraction on a complete closed ball, with C*R<=1/4; the derivative of id+B(x,x) is a unit, giving analytic open inverse charts.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.uniform_bounded_ball_quantifiers: For every B>=0 there is M such that for all m>=M and all complex H^-1 q with norm(q)<=B there are v with norm(v)<=4*B+1, an open U containing q, and an analytic s:U->L2 with s(q)=v and s(r)' +(m+1)*s(r)+s(r)^2=r for every r in U.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.L2_image_regularity: Any L2 v whose actual shifted Miura image is L2 has one full Sobolev derivative. The proof first obtains ell^(4/3), then Young gives v*v in ell2, and the derivative graph recovers H1.
Hminus1_shifted_Miura_chart_progress.exact_energy_translation: u=s(q)+(m+1)/2, so Miura(u)=q+(m+1)^2/4, with the constant inserted as the zeroth Fourier mode.

Hminus1_discriminant_progress.potential_space: All complex WeightedCoeff (Weight.sobolev (-1)) 2 in the H^-1 norm; original unit-period Fourier convention.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.L2_physical_comparison: Delta_Hminus(periodOneL2Inclusion(q),lambda)=hillL2Discriminant(periodDouble(q),lambda), for every complex unit-period L2 q and every complex energy.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.Miura_chart_energy_shift: (m+1)^2/4, inserted as the zeroth Fourier coefficient; energy is translated by the same constant.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.L2_Miura_trace_construction: The original diagonal canonical NLS trace is even in frequency by the physical H1 Miura identity and H1 density in L2. Cauchy-circle entire even descent gives joint energy/L2 analyticity.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.overlap_scope: All complex energies, every point of every open overlap, independent of mass and inverse branch; proved by physical L2 matching and density.
Hminus1_discriminant_progress.source_continuation_domain: Open domain where lambda is in the complex slit plane and Delta(s*q,lambda)^2-4 is nonzero for every real 0<=s<=1.

Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.potential_space: Full complex PeriodOneHminusOne = WeightedCoeff (Weight.sobolev (-1)) 2, in the unit-period Fourier convention.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.positive_frequency_indices: Natural positive high indices n, and PNat energy/moment indices; no negative-frequency statement is needed for the squared-energy construction.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.frequency_shift_bound: For Re(z)>0, norm(sqrt(z^2+c)-z)<=norm(c)/Re(z). Fixed shifts give uniformly small frequency and free-cosine errors on every sufficiently high closed disc.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.trace_quantifiers: For each q, each 0<r<=pi/4 and epsilon>0 there are N>0 and complex H^-1-open V containing q, before every a in V, every n>=N and every z in the full closed frequency disc centered n*pi with radius r.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.proof_of_trace_bound: Pull the existing exterior canonical NLS estimate through one analytic Miura chart, with the exact constant energy translation. Apply it at sqrt(z^2+c), transfer the free trace, fill each full disc by maximum modulus, then use compactness for source paths.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.actual_shifted_primitive_imaginary_strip: abs(Im(F+i*n*pi))<pi/2 on every admissible point of the full high quarter-pi disc.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.whole_disc_scope: One r>0, N>0 and complex H^-1-open V precede all n>=N; K_n is jointly analytic on the full closed energy disc E_n(r) times V, where E_n(r) has center (n*pi)^2 and radius n*pi*r.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.whole_square_zero_set: K_n=0 iff Delta_Hminus^2-4=0 on the full energy disc times V.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.whole_square_source_matching: K_n=(F+i*n*pi)^2 at every source-admissible point of the energy disc times V.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.joint_indexed_branch_limits: F tends to -i*n*pi in joint energy/H^-1 topology through every source-admissible direction at every actual branch point in the full high discs, including multiple zeros.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.comparison_bounds: norm(K_n+ (sqrt(lambda)-n*pi)^2)<=epsilon*r^2 and norm(K_n+(lambda-(n*pi)^2)^2/(4*(n*pi)^2))<=epsilon*r^2 on the full energy discs.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.root_confinement_proof: At a trace root Delta^2=4, four*norm(sin(z))^2<=five*epsilon for trace error epsilon<=1. The existing filled-sine quotient gives uniform small displacement.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.full_source_energy_shells_covered: For each rho>0, one N and complex H^-1-open V cover every rho*n<=norm(lambda-(n*pi)^2)<=n at every n>=N. Nonempty shells have rho<=1.
Hminus1_uniform_high_family_progress.actual_Arnold_period: A_n=hillHminusHighContourMoment n 0=-(1/pi)*integral_energy_circle F, center (n*pi)^2 and radius n.

Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.potential_space: Full complex unit-period PeriodOneHminusOne, with no real, mean-zero or regularity hypothesis.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.common_neighborhood_quantifiers: For every complex H^-1 potential q, there exist one complex H^-1-open V containing q, N>0 and C>0, before every a in V and every positive n>=N.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.quadratic_comparison_tolerance_scope: For each 0<epsilon<=1/16, a single V,N yield comparison by epsilon*r^2 and actual two-root data at every high index. V,N may depend on epsilon.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.pair_uniqueness_proof: The smaller concentric disc gives a submultiset of the larger with the same cardinality two. Exact analytic multiplicities force equality, including repeated roots.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.quotient_scope: Analytic on the complete closed energy disc, nonzero throughout the open disc, globally exact factorization K=(lambda-lambda_minus)*(lambda-lambda_plus)*Q.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.quotient_uniform_bound: norm(Q)<=4/(n*pi*r)^2 on the full closed energy disc.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.normalized_quotient: norm(4*(n*pi)^2*Q+1)<=epsilon on the complete closed disc.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.normalized_energy_analytic_unit_root: H^2=Q, H nonzero, norm(H-i/(2*n*pi))<=epsilon/(2*n*pi). Joint potential analyticity of the chosen unit root is not asserted.
Hminus1_quadratic_period_bounds_progress.period_normalization: A_n=-(1/pi)*integral F; R_n=(1/pi)*integral (F+i*n*pi)^3 on the actual radius-n energy circle.

common_action_family_descent_progress.scope: General analytic descent and the exact KdV-weighted positive-ell2 extension mechanism; physical KdV coordinate/invariance inputs remain explicit and unproved.
common_action_family_descent_progress.raw_action_formula_for_normalized_coordi: I_k=(x_k^2+y_k^2)/(2*w_k); for the KdV base action weight w_k=(1+positive_index(k))^(-1).
common_action_family_descent_progress.exact_summand_factor: 8*n*pi, n:PNat, with positive factor divided out only after simultaneous descent of the weighted terms.
common_action_family_descent_progress.positive_ell2_domain: The actual inverse image under baseActionInclusion of one constructed complex open neighborhood of the full weighted nonnegative action cone.

Hminus1_real_spectral_progress.potential_space: Every real unit-period H^-1 potential, specified by conjugate reflection of its raw Fourier coefficients.
Hminus1_real_spectral_progress.zero_persistence_hypotheses: A jointly continuous family of entire scalar functions, a dense parameter subset, and a non-identically-zero limit slice. Rouché controls an isolated zero disc; multiple zeros are included.
Hminus1_real_spectral_progress.reflection_sign: R(conj lambda,q)=-conj R(lambda,q), F(conj lambda,q)=-conj F(lambda,q).
